title: Targeted's Yellow hotbar
description: gives your hotbar selector an yellow colour
body:
This resource pack makes a small but impactful change to your Minecraft interface by turning the hotbar selector into a bright, easy-to-see yellow. While the default selector can sometimes blend into the background—especially in darker environments or fast-paced situations—this pack ensures your selected slot always stands out clearly.

The goal is to improve usability without straying from the vanilla look and feel. The yellow highlight fits naturally within Minecraft’s UI while providing better contrast, making it easier to quickly identify your active item during combat, building, or exploration.

This pack is perfect for players who want a subtle quality-of-life upgrade without completely overhauling the game’s visuals. It’s lightweight, clean, and designed to work alongside most other resource packs with little to no conflict.

Features:
✔ Bright yellow hotbar selector for improved visibility
✔ Minimal, vanilla-friendly design
✔ Lightweight and performance-friendly
✔ Compatible with most other resource packs

Whether you’re a casual player or someone who relies on quick hotbar switching, this pack helps you stay focused and in control—without changing the core Minecraft experience.
